notes: Three alternating pairs of fresh four-worker servers per workload. Idle: identical existing load client, 2000 joined sockets, 4 KiB initial reads, rates/heartbeats off; memory sampled at client ready before its two-second hold ends. Idle final native cleanup is not sampled by benchmark.trial. Churn: fixed fed6fff stress binary, 64 workers for 10 seconds, server CPUs 0-3 and client 4-7, rates off, heartbeat on; every lifecycle routes and verifies its application echo before departure. Churn CPU includes setup/teardown. All native final gauges including staging must release. Workloads are sequential, with no concurrent compilation or stress. This does not establish production capacity.

output.validation: monotonic 8-byte counter per worker, unique assigned sender ID, every self-message and close handshake verified; fixed latency histogram
